en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European town, likely from the early 20th century. In the foreground on the right is a prominent two‑storey corner building with ornate façades and window decorations; above the entrance the word "APOTHEKE" (pharmacy) is visible. There is a metal utility pole with wires, a gas-style street lamp, and cobblestone or dirt streets with a few pedestrians. Further down the street stand several multi‑storey townhouses, and in the distance a church-like or civic tower rises against a low hillside.
